name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Dragon Roll (Cooked Eel, Crab & Avocado)
whyItWorks: All ingredients in the Dragon Roll are fully cooked! Unagi and avocado provide smooth, healthy fats. Ask to hold toasted sesame seeds if you have stricturing Crohn's.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Dragon Roll; ask to hold toasted sesame seeds.
watchOuts: Request no sesame seeds if stricture-prone
